conditionalExecution: Only after complete200-game built-in and independent audits and candidateScore<0.5. No sampling from partial games or interim scores.
failureSelection: Visit opening indices0..99. For each opening, consider candidate moves in hybrid losses immediately followed by a shipped search, both non-mate scores abs<999000. Compute candidate-POV optimism gap: (hybrid score minus next shipped score) times +1 for candidate White or -1 for candidate Black. Require positive gap. Retain greatest gap in opening, ties by frozen task order then ply. Take first12 eligible distinct openings. This is evaluator/search disagreement, not a verified mistake.
nextAnalysis: Root may separately freeze deeper230k/1.44m-node shipped/expanded/hybrid comparisons at these exact positions; disagreement alone cannot establish an error.
representativeSelection: All candidate moves irrespective game outcome. Sort ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 fixed-node-representative-v1|taskId|ply|fenBefore. Take first12 distinct opening indices. No exclusion based on failure-slice overlap; report overlap explicitly.
retainedFields: complete searched prefix through sampled root
use: Unlabelled development review only; both slices remain separate and not fit/model-selection/holdout eligible. No new engine searches, training, or paid work in the sampler.
